description: This file defines the UploadImageTransformer class which implements Symfony's DataTransformerInterface. It provides methods to transform and reverse transform image data, converting data arrays into Image objects and saving them.

classes.name: UploadImageTransformer
classes.description: A data transformer for processing uploaded image data in a Symfony form, converting arrays to Image objects and saving them.

methods.name: transform
methods.description: Transforms an image data object into a format suitable for form display (currently returns null).

methods.name: reverseTransform
methods.description: Converts submitted image data (array) into Image objects, saving new images if needed.
